grounding.states: hard-boiled egg: about 9 to 12 minutes in boiling water, then into cold water

value.answer: Put the eggs in a pan of cold water, bring it to a boil, then simmer for about 9 to 12 minutes. Move them straight into cold water for a few minutes so they peel easier and the yolks don't get that grey ring. Bigger eggs take the top end of the range.
